# <required|degraded> <TAB> <fact> <TAB> <at least> <TAB> <title>: <why>. Facts: what vka_readiness.c reports, ram_gib (ActivityManager totalMem in GiB) and android.sdk.

# Memory: 6.3-8.1 GB resident while playing on the 16 GB phone (14.66 GiB totalMem), the note's Memory section; no phone with less has run it

column4: Memory: the game keeps 6-8 GB in use while playing, which a phone with less than about 12 GB cannot give it
Memory: tested on a 16 GB phone only; with less, Android may stop the game when memory runs short

column1: # The shader library's needs (android/SHADERS.md): 7 geometry shader modules (the terrain's culling pass: without the feature those draws are skipped, vka_shader.c),
# 161 modules write storage images without a format and 30 read them, every vertex module takes draw parameters, 2 read memory through buffer device addresses with 64-bit integers

column4: Geometry shaders: the terrain is drawn with them; without them those draws are skipped
Storage image writes without a format: most of the game's compute and effect shaders use them
Storage image reads without a format: some of the game's shaders use them
Shader draw parameters: every vertex shader of the game reads them
Buffer device addresses: two of the game's shaders read memory through them
64-bit integers in shaders: two of the game's shaders use them

column1: # Textures are sampled in their own compressed formats, BC and ASTC 8x8 (vka_tex.c: no CPU decoding; a format the GPU lacks leaves that texture out)

column4: BC compressed textures: the game's textures are sampled as they are, never decoded on the CPU
ASTC compressed textures: the game's textures are sampled as they are, never decoded on the CPU

column1: # The largest compute shader's shared memory (shader_facts.tsv): 11,904 bytes, below Vulkan's minimum of 16 KiB

column4: Compute shared memory: the game's largest compute shader takes 11,904 bytes
